method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

revisions.source:
President Tyler has defined the key issue of this election with his proposed annexation of Texas. James K. Polk, the Democrat, gained his nomination by favoring the measure. Henry Clay, the Whig, has more latitude.

The Liberty Party lurks as an abolitionist third party, and will pressure the Whigs. Conversely, John Tyler hopes to use the Texas issue to energize an independent campaign, if Polk wavers. Other campaign issues are tariffs, internal improvements, and the banking system.
revisions.zh:
泰勒总统提出吞并得克萨斯，使之成为本次大选的核心议题。民主党人詹姆斯·K.·波尔克凭借对这项措施的支持获得提名；辉格党人亨利·克莱则有更大的表态余地。

自由党作为废奴第三党伺机而动，将给辉格党施加压力。另一方面，如果波尔克动摇，约翰·泰勒便希望利用得克萨斯问题，为自己的独立竞选造势。其他竞选议题包括关税、国内公共工程和银行制度。

revisions.source: James K. Polk won the Democratic nomination as a dark horse candidate, after Martin Van Buren was rejected for being soft on the Texas issue. He is a former Speaker of the House, and also served as Governor of Tennessee. Polk's support is strongest in the South, but he must hold some Northern states to win. To do this, he could exploit the Oregon issue, fond memories of Andrew Jackson, and the emerging Catholic vote. Note that John Tyler has yet to formally renounce his independent bid.
revisions.zh: 马丁·范布伦因在得克萨斯问题上态度软弱而未获提名后，詹姆斯·K.·波尔克作为黑马，赢得了民主党提名。他曾任众议院议长和田纳西州州长。波尔克在南方的支持最强，但若想获胜，仍必须保住若干北方州。为此，他可以利用俄勒冈问题、人们对安德鲁·杰克逊的美好回忆，以及日益壮大的天主教选民群体。注意，约翰·泰勒尚未正式放弃独立参选。

revisions.source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1844 Election

Your first order of business will be to confirm the annexation of Texas. More generally you can fight for the expansion of the United States in line with the ideals of "Manifest Destiny". With a Democratic majority in Congress, you will have wide latitude to implement your program, after four years of Tyler's paralysis. Best wishes for your term in office.
revisions.zh:
恭喜！你赢得了1844年大选

你的首要任务将是确认吞并得克萨斯。更广泛地说，你可以遵循“天定命运”的理想，争取美国的领土扩张。民主党在国会占据多数，在经历泰勒执政四年的僵局之后，你将有很大余地推行自己的纲领。祝你任内顺利。

revisions.source:
Sorry. You have lost the 1844 Election

President Clay is sure to obstruct the annexation of Texas. Hopefully a new President can bring this to a better conclusion in four years. In the meantime, your voice may hold some influence, in an advisory capacity, with the Democratic majority in Congress. It is unlikely, however, that you will be nominated for President over the likes of Lewis Cass, James Buchanan, or others in 1848.
revisions.zh:
很遗憾，你输掉了1844年大选

克莱总统肯定会阻挠吞并得克萨斯。但愿四年后，一位新总统能让此事得到更好的解决。在此期间，你仍可为国会中的民主党多数派提供建议，发挥一定影响。不过，到了1848年，你恐怕很难压过刘易斯·卡斯、詹姆斯·布坎南等人，再次获得总统提名。

revisions.source:
Wow. No candidate has achieved a majority in the Electoral College

This is surely an unusual situation, given that no candidate besides yourself and Clay seemed poised to win an electoral vote. Fortunately, the Democrats have won a majority in the House and seem likely to confirm you as the ultimate winner. Best wishes for your term in office.
revisions.zh:
哇，没有候选人获得选举人票的过半数

这确实是个不寻常的局面，毕竟除了你和克莱，其他候选人似乎都没有赢得选举人票的希望。幸运的是，民主党已在众议院取得多数，看起来很可能最终选你为总统。祝你任内顺利。

revisions.source:
Henry Clay runs in a Presidential election for the third time, and begins as the favorite against Polk. He must quickly define a position on Texas. It will be difficult to do so without alienating some bloc of the Whigs.

Clay would prefer to keep slavery and expansion on the back-burner, and advance his own issues like tariffs, internal improvements, and a national currency. Can he find redemption from his political defeats to Andrew Jackson, and finally break into the White House?
revisions.zh:
亨利·克莱第三次角逐总统宝座，起初被看好能击败波尔克。他必须尽快明确对得克萨斯问题的立场，但无论如何表态，都很难不疏远辉格党内的某一派。

克莱更愿意把奴隶制和领土扩张暂放一边，推动自己重视的关税、国内公共工程和全国统一货币等主张。他能否洗刷以往在政治上败给安德鲁·杰克逊的失意，终于入主白宫？

revisions.source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1844 Election

Your first order of business will be to block the annexation of Texas, and hopefully to end the further discussion of this issue. Then you can concentrate on undoing the damage that Andrew Jackson and his followers have inflicted on the American System. Unfortunately, it appears that you will have to deal with a Democratic majority in Congress. Best wishes for these next four years.
revisions.zh:
恭喜！你赢得了1844年大选

你的首要任务将是阻止吞并得克萨斯，并希望就此结束对这一议题的进一步讨论。接着，你可以专心修复安德鲁·杰克逊及其追随者给“美国体系”造成的损害。可惜，你看来仍得与占据国会多数的民主党打交道。祝你未来四年顺利。

revisions.source:
Sorry. You have lost the 1844 Election

President Polk is sure to go through with the annexation of Texas. You can only hope it doesn't lead to war. Even if the U.S. is successful in the short-term, the acquisition of such territory is sure to reopen the slavery question in a way which may hurt the Whigs. As for your own fortunes, you have likely missed your last chance to become President. How will your legacy be remembered?
revisions.zh:
很遗憾，你输掉了1844年大选

波尔克总统肯定会推进吞并得克萨斯。你只能希望这不会引发战争。即使美国短期内取得成功，获得这片领土也必将重新引发奴隶制争论，可能损害辉格党的利益。至于你自己的前途，你很可能已经错过了成为总统的最后一次机会。后人将如何评价你的政治遗产？

revisions.source:
Wow. No candidate has achieved a majority in the Electoral College

This is sure an unusual situation, given that no candidate besides yourself and Polk seemed poised to win an electoral vote. Unfortunately, the Democrats have won a majority in the House and seem likely to confirm James K. Polk as the ultimate winner. How will your legacy be remembered?
revisions.zh:
哇，没有候选人获得选举人票的过半数

这确实是个不寻常的局面，毕竟除了你和波尔克，其他候选人似乎都没有赢得选举人票的希望。可惜，民主党已在众议院取得多数，看起来很可能最终选詹姆斯·K.·波尔克为总统。后人将如何评价你的政治遗产？

revisions.source: George Dallas has served as a Pennsylvania Senator, and as Mayor of Philadelphia. Pennsylvania is a crucial state to win if the Democrats are to return to the White House. Dallas would balance the ticket in two ways. First, he is a Northerner. Secondly, he is a moderate on the issues of tariffs and banking, compared to Polk, Jackson, and most other Southerners. He is not a moderate on the issue of expansion, and would help define that as the central Democratic issue in this election.
revisions.zh: 乔治·达拉斯曾任代表宾夕法尼亚州的联邦参议员和费城市长。民主党若想重返白宫，必须争取宾夕法尼亚。他能从两个方面平衡竞选组合：首先，他是北方人；其次，与波尔克、杰克逊及多数南方人相比，他在关税和银行问题上较为温和。但在领土扩张问题上，他并不温和，能帮助民主党将其确立为本届大选的核心议题。

revisions.source: Dallas is the preferred choice of the Convention, but Polk could intervene on behalf of Levi Woodbury. Woodbury's reputation is more national than Dallas's, but he also comes from a smaller state. Woodbury has served as Secretary of the Treasury and is much more orthodox on economic issues, favoring a limited view of the federal government's powers. This could galvanize Democrats in the closer states in the South and West, but could also be a hindrance in Pennsylvania and New York.
revisions.zh: 达拉斯是党代会属意的人选，但波尔克可以出面支持利维·伍德伯里。伍德伯里在全国的名望比达拉斯更高，却来自较小的州。他曾任财政部长，经济立场更符合党内传统，主张限制联邦政府权力。这能激励南方和西部选情胶着州的民主党人，却也可能成为争取宾夕法尼亚和纽约的障碍。

revisions.source: Theodore Frelinghuysen has served as a Senator from New Jersey, and as Mayor of Newark. He is known as something of an evangelist, being involved in numerous bible societies and advocating for moral uplift. Associates of Frelinghuysen have voiced anti-Catholic sympathies, however. His selection would help with nativists, but exacerbate the Whigs' problems with the Catholic vote. Southerners with a long memory also recall his loud opposition to the Indian Removal Act.
revisions.zh: 西奥多·弗里林海森曾任代表新泽西州的联邦参议员和纽瓦克市长。他参与许多圣经公会，倡导道德提升，颇有福音传道者的名声。但他的交往对象曾发表反天主教言论。选择他能吸引本土主义者，却会加剧辉格党争取天主教选民的困难。一些记性很好的南方人，也还记得他曾高声反对《印第安人迁移法》。

revisions.source: John Sergeant ran with Henry Clay in 1832, and has served in Congress on three occasions. He worked for the Second Bank of the United States, and strongly favors a revival of the national banking system. He is also known as an opponent of slavery, even voting against the Missouri Compromise in 1820. Obviously, this background could help Clay in certain regions, and hurt him in others. Sergeant has also been out of political office for over three years.
revisions.zh: 约翰·萨金特在1832年曾与亨利·克莱搭档，先后三次担任国会议员。他曾为美国第二银行工作，坚定支持恢复国家银行制度。他也以反对奴隶制著称，甚至在1820年投票反对密苏里妥协案。显然，这些经历能在某些地区帮助克莱，却在另一些地区拖累他。萨金特也已离开公职三年多。

revisions.source: Millard Fillmore was an influential Congressman before leaving that body in 1843. He has strongly supported Whig economic policies such as a tariff and national bank. He has taken stances against the expansion of slavery, without veering into the dangerous territory of abolitionism. He is well-connected to New York politics, and his selection would undoubtedly motivate the party in that crucial state.
revisions.zh: 米勒德·菲尔莫尔在1843年离任前，是一位有影响力的众议员。他坚定支持关税、国家银行等辉格党经济政策，反对奴隶制扩张，却没有涉足废奴主义这一政治危险地带。他在纽约政坛人脉深厚，选择他无疑能激励这一关键州的本党力量。
